tickets.title: Analyze mortgage rate reset timing for refinance decision
tickets.text: Analyze the mortgage servicer's rate change notice for Liora Nettlewhisk's primary mortgage to provide a recommendation before the adjustable rate reset window, enabling a decision on locking a refinance quote or staying with the current lender.
tickets.evidence: For loan reset timing analysis, the mortgage servicer’s notice shows an upcoming rate change window, and the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.title: Collect missing HELOC statement pages for debt modeling
tickets.text: Obtain the missing HELOC statement pages including margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language from the mortgage servicer to model the combined debt picture for Liora Nettlewhisk.
tickets.evidence: For HELOC document collection, the portal file contains only a partial HELOC statement, and the missing pages include the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-20.

tickets.title: Reconcile property tax and insurance estimates for cash-flow projection
tickets.text: Reconcile the differing monthly property tax and insurance amounts between the mortgage servicer's escrow estimate and Liora Nettlewhisk's household budget to clarify the projected payment after the loan reset.
tickets.evidence: For the cash-flow discrepancy review, the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Resolve duplicate HELOC autopay draft with Teacup Comet Bank
tickets.text: Address the duplicate HELOC autopay draft by Teacup Comet Bank that reduced Liora Nettlewhisk's checking cushion and forced a savings transfer before payroll, and implement reserve protection.
tickets.evidence: For the bank autopay issue and reserve protection, Liora reported that Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.
